market.question: Will the highest temperature in New York City be between 70-71°F on May 4?

assessment.reasoning: NYC forecast for May 4, 2026 puts the high at 68°F with overnight low 56°F. The market resolves YES if highest temp lands in 70-71°F bucket. Forecast at 68°F is just 2°F below the 70-71 bucket, within forecast uncertainty. Probability of upside surprise into 70-71 (vs landing at 68/69 or higher 72+) is moderate but not the central case.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Forecast verification within +/-2°F band; sun/cloud breaks could push high higher.
